definitions.explanation: The act of going to school to attend classes. Used specifically for students traveling to and arriving at their school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{八時|はちじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{登校|とうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I go to school at eight every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{登校|とうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
examples.english: School attendance was canceled due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{登校|とうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嫌|いや}がる→嫌がる：03041_iyagaru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: My son has recently started to resist going to school.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Specifically refers to students going to school — not used for teachers or other staff (they use ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧). The opposite is ⟦{下校|げこう}→下校：16177_gekou⟧ (leaving school to go home).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登校|とうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to attend school)
- {登校|とうこう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time to go to school)
- {登校|とうこう}⟦{拒否|きょひ}→拒否：08242_kyohi⟧ (school refusal)
- ⟦{不登校|ふとうこう}→不登校：11317_futoukou⟧ (truancy, school non-attendance)
- {登校|とうこう}{日|び} (school day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧: commuting to school — focuses on the commute itself, not the arrival
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧: attendance — being present at class, not the act of going
